input.question: q-C-02
input.text: How long can checks deposited to a new account be held?

clauses.text: Checks deposited to a new account may be held for up to 7 days.
clauses.title: Holds on New Accounts

clauses.text: How long an account counts as new | 30 days
clauses.title: New Account Quick Reference

clauses.text: How long an account counts as new | 30 days

clauses.text: New accounts can have check holds of as long as 7 business days.

clauses.text: New accounts can have check holds of as long as 9 business days.
